local_verification: Full network, handlers, metrics and server-transport suites passed with temporary Windows socket compile shims outside the repository.
Relevant client backend/UDP/mux regressions passed three repetitions with the same compile shims.
Linux-targeted repository-wide go vet and e2e test binary build passed.
limitations: Three timed samples per revision on one host do not prove production no-regression or a general performance improvement.
Median p99 is 1.743 ms for the composition vs 1.643 ms for main; latency improvement or equality is not claimed.
Fixed 200 Mbit/s offered application load is not maximum tunnel capacity.
CPU, heap and RSS include both engines, the backend and load generator. They are not the cost of one production endpoint.

The resource fixture verifies 64 quiet users before load and holds them during load; its after-load counters do not verify their continuing usability. The separate retirement test verifies one silent user after actual retirement.
Post-load heap/goroutine snapshots occur before fixture cleanup and are not quiescent leak measurements.
The fixture reports p99 but not p50/p95 or exact fresh-probe count; any fresh-probe error fails the run.
No native race-enabled run or full previous-release interoperability matrix was performed.
No production services or kernel-wide policies changed. The raised FD soft limit applied only to the isolated retirement process. Temporary directories were removed on both hosts.
